Let’s talk CYSTEAMINE vs TGA 👀🧪✨

Not all lash lift and brow lamination products work in the same way!

Traditional TGA (thioglycolic acid/thioglycolate) systems and cysteamine-based systems both work by breaking down disulfide bonds in the hair, allowing us to reshape the lashes or brows.

So why do I love working with cysteamine-based products? 🤍

✨ A different approach to lifting – Cysteamine-based formulations can work at a lower pH than some traditional TGA systems, potentially reducing the amount of alkaline stress placed on the hair.

✨ A focus on hair integrity – When correctly formulated and used, cysteamine systems can be a great option for achieving beautiful results while prioritising the condition of the natural lashes and brows.

✨ Beautiful, soft-looking results – I love the flexibility and finish I can achieve with my DALBY products, especially for Korean lash lifts and soft, fluffy brow laminations.

But here's the important part: cysteamine doesn't automatically mean damage-free! Product formulation, processing times, hair condition and correct technique all play a huge role in protecting hair integrity.

For me, it's about understanding the chemistry behind the products I use and choosing the right system for the treatment. 🫶

My Dalby favourites are cysteamine-based, and I've been loving incorporating them into my lash and brow treatments!

Why the white mapping dots on her lids?

Before I apply anything, I always map first. Those white dots mark the true center of the iris, and the inner & outer points of the iris.
This helps me know exactly where to increase lengths and where to place my signature wisps for balance and symmetry.

What’s really important to notice is how close the “center” dots appear to the inner corner when the eyes are closed. This is why mapping on a closed eye without referencing the iris can be misleading.

If I assumed the center of the eyelid was the center of the eye, the entire set could end up sitting wrong — throwing off proportions and creating a style that doesn’t actually suit the client’s eye shape.

✨ This is the difference between placing lashes and designing lashes.

If you want to truly understand eye shapes, intentional mapping, and how to customize every set — this is exactly the kind of detail I teach my students in my courses & masterclasses.

✨ 3 things I will ONLY use for brows ✨
Because brow hair + brow skin deserve better. Always.

1️⃣ Hot wax (and I won’t budge on this)
Hot wax grips the hair, not the skin — which means:
✔️ less irritation
✔️ more precision
✔️ fewer broken hairs
✔️ smoother regrowth
Soft wax can tug, overstimulate the skin and cause unnecessary redness — especially in such a delicate area. Brows need control, not trauma.

2️⃣ AquaDrops by Infinity for hybrid brows
Hybrid brows need more than just pigment — they need protection.
AquaDrops contain a bonding agent, which means: ✔️ stronger brow hairs during processing
✔️ better pigment attachment
✔️ longer-lasting colour
✔️ less dryness or brittleness
So instead of stressing the hair, we’re reinforcing it while tinting. Strong brows = better results.

3️⃣ Cystamine-based lamination solutions (NOT TGA)
This one’s big 👀
Cystamine works more gently than traditional TGA solutions by:
✔️ breaking bonds in a controlled way
✔️ reducing irritation risk
✔️ protecting hair integrity
✔️ being safer for sensitive skin
It gives the lift we want without over-processing or compromising brow health.

Bottom line:
Healthy brows > harsh shortcuts.
Every product I use has a purpose — and your brows feel the difference.
